svg.aria-label: Data flow of job-radar, table by table. Job boards and APIs, company career pages and Gmail job alerts load raw.job_posting; the ECB's rates load raw.fx_rate. Transform builds core.job (one row per job) with the companies, places, role tracks and rates; match_skills adds core.job_skill and core.skill_day; transform keeps core.job_history, core.job_archive and core.job_seen. Four mart views serve the daily emails and the Streamlit tracker; the website reads core tables through Neon. 20 tables and views, 25 reads between them.
svg.title: job-radar data flow
